title: Public reader section quality correction
summary: Project iteration record for fixing public AI daily reader-section regressions: the page no longer duplicates main stories through a `完整列表`, the retained main details are renamed and expanded, GitHub Trending descriptions prefer concrete README/project context, Builder/X cards tolerate missing optional fields, and community leads are expanded into reader-useful summaries.

validation_commands: node --test tests/unit.test.js --test-name-pattern "public daily renders one expanded renamed main detail section without compact full list|GitHub Trending descriptions prefer concrete README or project context over ranking boilerplate|builder discussion renders with missing optional Twitter fields|community lead cards expand short summaries to reader-useful context"

lessons.lesson: Reader-facing layout fixes should remove old competing surfaces, not add a new layer beside them.
lessons.evidence: The previous must-read improvement kept a duplicate `完整列表` plus collapsed `主体细节`, so the public page had two main-story streams and hid the richer one.
lessons.recommended_action: Bind public layout changes to page checklist and e2e assertions that check both the desired section and the absence of deprecated sections.

lessons.lesson: Safe-sounding fallback copy can become worse than an empty field when it repeats across GitHub Trending rows.
lessons.evidence: Generic text such as `进入 GitHub Trending Top 10` and README/license reminders passed as Chinese prose but did not explain the repository capability.
lessons.recommended_action: Prefer README/project summaries; when no concrete summary exists, publish only transparent minimal context such as language/rank/star movement instead of inventing usefulness.

suggestions.issue: Public reader sections could regress in four places at once: duplicate main lists, generic GitHub copy, blank Builder cards, and thin community summaries.
suggestions.evidence: Unit tests now cover the layout, GitHub boilerplate filtering, Builder/X fallback rendering, and community lead density; the e2e checklist checks the built HTML.
suggestions.suggestion: Keep `重点详情` as the single main-detail stream, filter GitHub boilerplate before rendering, make Builder cards title/body safe, and expand community leads to around 100 Chinese characters.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future daily reports remain scan-friendly without hiding useful context or filling public sections with repeated low-information prose.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented in interaction shaping, draft fallback text, page checklist, unit/e2e tests, feedback ledger, and quick-reference documentation.
